skill.name: obsidian-epoch
skill.invoke: Use references/web-llm-bridge-playbook.md to hand a single safe turn to a browser-only model.

notes: Browser-only model sessions cannot install MCP, so an installed host or web console must generate and submit the bridge turn.
The browser model sees only visible context and server-issued actionOptionId values; prose never becomes canonical settlement.

steps.purpose: Issue a visible-context turn package that a browser-only model can read.
Submit only the server-issued actionOptionId and browser model rationale.
Publish the server-settled bridge result after obsidian_epoch.result_page returns a publish token.
